name: ServiceNow MCP Server
description: Enables Claude to interact with ServiceNow instances for incident management, service catalog operations, change requests, knowledge base management, user administration, and agile project workflows through various authentication methods.

rawRecord.description: Enables Claude to interact with ServiceNow instances for incident management, service catalog operations, change requests, knowledge base management, user administration, and agile project workflows through various authentication methods.

MCP_TOOL_PACKAGE.description: The name of the tool package to load (e.g., service_desk, catalog_builder, change_coordinator, knowledge_author, platform_developer, system_administrator, agile_management, full, none). Defaults to 'full' if not set.

SERVICENOW_API_KEY.description: Your ServiceNow API key for API key authentication

SERVICENOW_PASSWORD.description: Your ServiceNow password for basic authentication

SERVICENOW_USERNAME.description: Your ServiceNow username for basic authentication

SERVICENOW_AUTH_TYPE.description: The authentication method to use (basic, oauth, or api_key)

SERVICENOW_CLIENT_ID.description: Your ServiceNow OAuth client ID for OAuth authentication

SERVICENOW_TOKEN_URL.description: The OAuth token URL for your ServiceNow instance (e.g., https://your-instance.service-now.com/oauth_token.do)

SERVICENOW_INSTANCE_URL.description: The URL of your ServiceNow instance (e.g., https://your-instance.service-now.com)

SERVICENOW_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Your ServiceNow OAuth client secret for OAuth authentication
